chunks: By your Lord, We shall gather them and the devils together, then bring them crawling on their knees around Hell.
ai.seo_question: How will disbelievers and devils be gathered on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Mary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the intimate association between humans and devils, noting that the disbelievers will be gathered alongside their demonic allies, emphasizing the culmination of their reckoning. The posture of 'crawling' (jithiyan) signifies their total humiliation and inability to stand before divine justice, a state contrasting with the upright posture of the righteous. This gathering underscores the concept of divine retribution where the agents of misguidance are presented as witnesses against those they misled.
